selectionGuide.description: Four vertically ordered panels pair increasingly luminous brain imagery with ideas presented as progressively more advanced.
bestFor: ranking four approaches from basic to supposedly transcendent
escalating an ordinary idea into an absurdly sophisticated conclusion
an ironic hierarchy where the final answer is extreme rather than sensible
avoidWhen: the entries have no intelligible order or escalation
each level needs long explanatory prose

mechanics.visual: Each successive brain glows more intensely, so the layout visually claims increasing insight whether the ranking is sincere or ironic.
mechanics.text: Fill level1 through level4 in ascending order with concise, comparable clauses; reserve level4 for the most extreme or enlightened claim.
